methodology.aggregation: Retune means weighted by each direction and run sample count using recorded three-decimal means; maxima are worst observed. Histogram percentile fields are bucket upper bounds.
methodology.priority: Single existing radio/UI owner on core1. Priority3 only scopes radio retune, then restores priority1; no separate radio task.
methodology.synthetic_load: 250 microsecond CPU burst every two RTOS ticks, priority1 on the owner core.
methodology.spi_frequency: Clock-divider-derived configured frequency, not an oscilloscope measurement.
limits: No decoded packets in the controlled trials
No Bluetooth or WiFi workload in the receive-only harness
Short five-second controlled trials and three-second sweep trials
Preliminary failing bulk-read observations are not a transceiver or board maximum-clock claim

preliminary_spi_sweep.interpretation: Observed bulk-transfer failures for this implementation. Later bytewise and clock-register comparisons do not establish a causal driver defect or a physical clock limit. Frequencies are derived from the configured divider, not measured on a clock signal.

tests.status: 23 focused native tests,7 hosted-document tests, final HIL build, Full build/smoke and controlled sustained BLE duration check passed. Requested10Hz BLE rate was not reached.

hil_final_source_build.scope: Final HIL source with clock experiment helpers isolated under tools/hil.

selection.scope: Tested T-Deck only; short receive-only timing and read checks
selection.reason: Highest bulk clock that passed this board/session checks. Confirmed modem and IQ caches reduce command work. Scoped priority did not improve maximum complete service gap.
selection.limits: Not a physical transceiver maximum, loaded RF qualification, or a general guarantee across boards.

clock_register_conclusion: Some N/pre/phase arithmetic differed from the experimental reconstruction. Register correction was rejected: 8.888888 MHz changed from zero bad modem reads in 10000 pairs to 587; at10MHz errors remained58/1000 versus64/1000. These observations do not explain every case or establish a causal driver bug. Correction remains HIL-only.

linked_ram_gate.interpretation: Linked capacity, not live free heap.

runtime_smoke_checks.limitations: Ambient primary packets, not controlled packet delivery.

runtime_smoke_checks.lifetime_max_interpretation: Present before this active test, following prior single-profile teardown; not attributed to active-pair retuning.

earlier_incomplete_attempt.interpretation: 69 successful DEVICE_INFO queries followed by timeout. This earlier attempt overlapped administrative settings writes and did not complete the requested workload; no cause is established.

controlled_sustained_retry.setup_and_cleanup_policy: Screen and temporary secondary configured before BLE traffic. USB stayed open without configuration mutations during traffic. Cleanup followed child completion.
controlled_sustained_retry.interpretation: Passed30-second sustained-duration check,208 successful replies at achieved6.886Hz rather than requested10Hz. Does not establish300-query acceptance or explain the earlier timeout.

radio_overlap.lifetime_max_interpretation: Already present before BLE traffic following earlier teardown, not an active-pair retune maximum.

selected_clock_cached_retune_envelope.scope: Final same-image cached9MHz-request cases: modem cache at32 symbols; modem+IQ cache at40 symbols. Distinct from Full Companion application smoke maximum1224us.

full_screen_redraw_summary.aggregation: Frame-sample-weighted means; extrema over recorded frame timings.
full_screen_redraw_summary.interpretation: Typical73.6ms to57.1ms, approximately16.5ms saved or22percent less time; worst75.131ms to57.964ms. Includes radio cooperation. Original and final use different images and combined policies; most gain is canvas rendering, not an isolated above8MHz bus comparison.
